title: YOLO26-seg actual training TAL sparse assignment trace and checkpoint comparison
question: Do supervised raw locations and per-GT TAL coverage evolve during actual training, and can this be distinguished from frozen-checkpoint replay?
scope: Code draft only. No training, no parity smoke or performance benchmark has been executed. Full COCO pretraining is explicitly out of scope. Sparse TAL tracing is OPTIONAL, only for a separately justified fine-tuning trajectory study.
compute_constraint_decision: Do not train from scratch to reproduce official COCO weight. Start from pinned official pretrained checkpoint; first use frozen official TAL and raw/GT replay. If testing new supervision, use identical checkpoint and budget paired fine-tune, not a from-scratch recipe.
blockers: Preflight G0 requires hook integration with real criterion, enhanced GT lineage, and loss/gradient parity smoke.
In mask-coefficient-only training with frozen class/box predictions and upstream features, TAL is invariant for the same input; stepwise tracing has no information gain for assignment dynamics.
